observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== p12 key files ==="; ls -la config/*.p12; echo; echo "=== CA certs ==="; ls -la config/certificates/; echo; echo "=== frontends ==="; for p in 8082 8081 8080; do echo -n "$p: "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 8 http://localhost:$p/; done; echo "=== api pings ==="; for p in 8100 8101 8102 8103 8104 8105; do echo -n "$p /test/ping: "; curl -s --max-time 8 http://localhost:$p/test/ping | head -c 60; echo; done
